question: How many delivery partners does Swiggy need in Pune for its food delivery operations?
idealClarificationQuestions: Active partners (delivered at least 1 order in past week)? Yes.
Pune metro / PMC + PCMC area? Yes (~7M population).
Captive + gig contractors? All Swiggy-affiliated delivery partners.
Average day, not festival peak? Average.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Daily orders → delivery time per order → partner working hours → partners needed.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Pune food delivery monthly orders (Swiggy alone, ~50% market share of ~9M monthly): ~4.5M.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Peak hours (lunch + dinner) absorb ~70% = 105K orders in ~6 peak hours.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: But not all partners work full peak: average partner does ~6-8 deliveries per day. Daily 150K orders ÷ 7 = ~21K partner-shifts/day.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~25,000-30,000 active Swiggy delivery partners in Pune.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Average orders per delivery partner per peak hour

benchmarkAssumptions.value: 105K orders ÷ 6 hours ÷ 3 orders/partner = ~5,800 partners on-shift simultaneously.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: But not all partners work full peak
benchmarkAssumptions.value: average partner does ~6-8 deliveries per day. Daily 150K orders ÷ 7 = ~21K partner-shifts/day.
~25,000-30,000 active Swiggy delivery partners in Pune.

calculationFlow: Peak hours (lunch + dinner) absorb ~70% = 105K orders in ~6 peak hours.
Peak-hour fleet needed: 105K orders ÷ 6 hours ÷ 3 orders/partner = ~5,800 partners on-shift simultaneously.
But not all partners work full peak: average partner does ~6-8 deliveries per day. Daily 150K orders ÷ 7 = ~21K partner-shifts/day.
If average partner works 5 days/week: 21K shifts × 7/5 = ~30K active weekly partners.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: ~25,000-30,000 active Swiggy delivery partners in Pune.
